author: TeIq
content: Closed. Bumped aes-gcm from 0.10 to 0.11.0-rc.3 (workspace-pinned). Migrated 4× cipher init call sites from deprecated Key::<Aes256Gcm>::from_slice → Aes256Gcm::new_from_slice (KeyInit trait, returns Result, maps to SigningError::KeyDecrypt on degenerate-length inputs). Migrated 4× nonce sites from deprecated Nonce::from_slice → typed [u8; 12] arr → Nonce::<Aes256Gcm>::from(arr). Updated Aead::encrypt/decrypt calls to take &nonce per the 0.11 signature. Removed all 6× #[allow(deprecated)] blocks. Zero build warnings, clippy clean, fmt clean. 25/25 signer lib tests + 3/3 key_rotation integration tests pass. Pin back to 0.10 if the RC introduces a regression — call sites are narrow.
